infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Apex UGR uses your location while the app is open to track drives, reveal the world map, show nearby events, and provide navigation.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Apex UGR uses the camera when you add vehicle photos or race proof media.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Apex UGR uses your photo library when you choose vehicle photos or race videos to upload.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Apex UGR needs access to your GPS location for real-time driver radar, telemetry logging, and car meet navigation.

plugins.cameraPermission: Apex UGR uses the camera to scan encrypted Apex IDs and capture vehicle media.

plugins.photosPermission: Apex UGR accesses your photo library to save generated Ghost Run share cards.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Apex UGR saves generated Ghost Run share cards to your photo library.
